https://www.gog.com/game/stormbridge

Can you build the longest bridge before the storm catches up? Stormbridge is a roguelite city builder about growth, survival, and watching everything fall apart. Stay ahead of the danger, unlock upgrades between runs, and uncover the storm’s origin.

Manage your resources as you build, survive, and stay ahead of the relentless storm on your tail. Unlock new epic buildings, build shields to protect your structures, or place turrets and go on the offensive. Brave blizzards and fiery tornadoes - and discover ways to neutralize them before they tear your bridge apart.

Can you build the longest bridge and stay ahead of the danger?
